summary: Aris Mining filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated September 29, 2026, congratulating Founder, Chair and CEO Neil Woodyer on his induction into the Canadian Mining Hall of Fame, with the ceremony set for January 14, 2027 in Toronto. The release recounts his career and notes Ian Telfer and Frank Giustra as fellow Hall members and Aris shareholders. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor or regulatory clock is disclosed; the filing is a routine foreign-private-issuer disclosure of an honorary corporate announcement, not a special situation. No deal terms to watch.
